definitions.short: properly, an investigation , i.e. (by implication) a treatise or elaborate compilation
definitions.full: H4097. midrash [ מִדְרָשׁ ] noun [masculine] study, exposition, midrash , only construct מִדְרַשׁ (late; common in Late Hebrew, in sense of imaginative exposition or didactic story ) — הַמְּלָכִים סֵפֶר מִדְרַשׁ midrash of the book of Kings 2Chr 24:27 ; עִדּוֺ הַנָּבִיא מִדְרַשׁ midrash of the prophet Iddo 13:22 . These were probably of a didactic character, compare Dr Intr 497 .
